project.name: neko-cloud-pilot
project.purpose: Native macOS voice input app with an additive GCP Codex documentation pilot.

precedence_notes: Desktop workspace rules are inherited from the parent workspace; app install/release and website publication are separate tasks.

commands.notes: Cloud container build and runtime checks are in .github/workflows/neko-cloud-pilot.yml; native checks require macOS.

external_integrations: GCP Cloud Run / GCS / Secret Manager

patterns: Existing scripts/build.sh and scripts/test-all.sh are the native CI entry points.
Cloud runner emits private patches; a separate publisher checks the fixed docs scope.
naming: Task IDs are lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
error_handling: Cloud setup stops at the first failed command.
logging: Model output is stored only in a private GCS task log.
tests: Cloud offline tests use Python unittest fixtures without live API calls.
conventions.notes: A successful Linux fixture is not native macOS or deployed-cloud proof.

protected_areas.reason: Approved cat assets and release resources

minimum_after_change: consumer regression checks for shared changes
final diff and git status review
manual_checks: Physical microphone, accessibility permissions, actual UI and updater installation need separate device verification.

known_unknowns: OpenAI credential setup is deferred; live model execution remains unverified.
Secret Manager mount and Responses proxy with a real key remain unverified.

evidence.fact: macOS CI builds and runs offline regression scripts.
Cloud pilot limits generated output to two documentation paths.
Canonical version/build and updater configuration are release inputs.
Trusted-branch preflight verifies the Cloud Run sandbox and fixed-SHA GCS audit before model work.
